name: frappe_ping
description:
Check connectivity and credentials against the configured Frappe/ERPNext site.
Use first when another tool fails, to tell a network or credential problem apart from a bad doctype or document name. This is a diagnostic, not a data tool — it never reads or writes documents.
Behavior: read-only and idempotent, with no side effects. A pong proves the site is reachable and that FRAPPE_API_KEY/FRAPPE_API_SECRET authenticate; it does not prove the API user has permission for any particular DocType. Failure surfaces as a connection error (site unreachable, wrong URL, TLS problem) or an auth error (bad key or secret).
Parameters: none by design — the target site and credentials come from the server's own environment, never from the caller, so this tool cannot be aimed at a different host.
Returns: {"message": "pong"}.
